sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: Use this guide when someone does not fade on schedule: an ex the user is over but still dreams about, a stranger from one afternoon, a friend who feels older than the friendship. Synastry does not tell the user to call them. It explains why the bond feels the way it does, so the user can stop blaming themselves for not getting over it fast enough.

sections.heading: Core Guardrail
sections.body: One aspect proves nothing. Read the whole chart. Two grown people matter more than any single contact. Intensity is not compatibility. Hard to forget is not meant to be. The chart can describe force, familiarity, longing, and friction; it cannot turn a feeling into an obligation.

sections.heading: Saturn Glue
sections.body: Look at Saturn: time, weight, structure, and consequence. When one person's Saturn hits the other's Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars, or lunar nodes, the bond can feel serious, heavy, and hard to end. Sometimes that is loyalty. Sometimes it is a cage. Heavy Saturn contacts are a flag, not an automatic blessing. A bond can stick because it is deep, or because it is trapping someone. The reading has to know the difference.

items.label: Constructive Use
items.body: Name what the connection asks each person to build, repair, commit to, or take seriously. Saturn is useful when it creates clean responsibility.

items.label: Caution
items.body: Do not romanticize heaviness. If the bond runs on guilt, control, fear, or one-sided responsibility, the weight is not proof of love.

sections.heading: South Node Familiarity
sections.body: The South Node is the already-familiar. When someone's Sun, Moon, Venus, or personal planet lands there, the user may feel like they have known the person for years inside ten minutes. The feeling is real. It is also a pull backward toward what is known, not automatically toward what is good. Known and good are not the same thing.

sections.heading: North Node Growth
sections.body: North Node contacts can feel less comfortable because they ask for a newer version of the self. They can bring new choices, new standards, and the stretch toward what the user is becoming. South Node can feel easy because it is familiar. North Node can feel harder because it is alive.

sections.heading: Dreaming And The Unconscious
sections.body: Dreams run on the unconscious. If the user keeps dreaming about someone, look for 12th-house overlays, Neptune contacts, and Black Moon Lilith contacts. The person may be living in the user's inner world longer than the actual relationship earned.

sections.heading: 12th-House Overlays
sections.body: When one person's planets fall into the other's 12th house, the connection works under the surface. The user carries them around without meaning to. They may show up in sleep, projection, secrecy, compassion, spiritual sensitivity, avoidance, or a feeling that is easier to feel than explain.

sections.heading: Neptune Idealization
sections.body: Neptune dissolves the line between the real person and the version the user invented. It can bring tenderness, inspiration, spiritual resonance, and creative longing. It can also create fantasy, projection, excuses, and attachment to potential instead of behavior. If the user is dreaming about someone they barely know, they may have fallen for the dream, not the data.

sections.heading: Black Moon Lilith Magnetism
sections.body: Black Moon Lilith contacts can feel raw, magnetic, exposed, and difficult to control. They can describe charged dreams, desire, shame, refusal, projection, and the pull that skips past good sense. Keep this optional and secondary, especially in mainstream relationship views.

sections.heading: Pluto Bonds
sections.body: Pluto is depth, intensity, fixation, survival instinct, and power. Pluto contacts can create jealousy, obsession, compulsion, and the feeling that another person changed the user's internal landscape. They do not release on command. Knowing it is Pluto is not proof the people belong together. It means this kind of pull can fade slowly, so the user should stop reading slow recovery as failure and choose on purpose, not by gravity.

sections.heading: Vertex And Juno
sections.body: Vertex contacts can make a brief meeting feel enormous, especially when a personal planet or node is involved. Juno can add a settled, commitment-flavored recognition. Significance and length are not the same thing. A connection can be real, mean something, and still be short by design.

sections.heading: Non-Romantic Bonds
sections.body: This framework reads friends, siblings, mentors, collaborators, and strangers as well as romance. Saturn shows time and duty. Pluto shows transformation, rarely gentle. Neptune shows ideals, inspiration, and sometimes illusion. The nodes show what feels already known and what stretches the user forward.

sections.heading: Agency
sections.body: This is for clarity, not for staying stuck. Knowing why someone is hard to forget does not mean the user has to keep them, wait, go back, or keep analyzing. If studying the chart becomes another way of holding on, the insight has stopped helping. Use the reading to move. If it keeps the user circling, redirect toward the present.

sections.heading: Safety
sections.body: Intensity is not a green light. A bond can be magnetic and bad for the user at the same time. If the connection involves control, fear, coercion, surveillance, isolation, or harm, that is not love and no chart explains it away. Lead with safety and real-world support.
